item_short_desc: Rothco’s Magnesium Firestarter with Striker features a lightweight and compact design that makes it perfect for camping or EDC (everyday carry).
description: Rothco’s Magnesium Firestarter with Striker features a lightweight and compact design that makes it perfect for camping or EDC (everyday carry). Simply scrape the magnesium bar with the steel striker to create a small mound of tinder, then strike the flint-strike edge to produce a small flame.
